scope: Completed case and its two scientific panels only; ten other runs and the complete scientific report remain pending.
checks: Completed at configured 400 years with unchanged source, executable, and configuration hashes and exit code zero.
History and saved profiles reach the same terminal step and time; all accepted-step errors are at most one.
All saved fields and histories are finite with positive effective normal stress.
Panel coordinates, values, and cumulative-slip profiles match direct selections of this completed run exactly.
Slip panel retains the last two complete cycles; every current pipeline hash agrees with its sidecar.

findings: Velocity map has a locked upper region and deeper creep with a closing upward-propagating earthquake.
The last interval is 64.0 years versus approximately 50 years in the paper; intervals continue to shorten from 70.7 to 64.0 years, so a steady recurrence period is not established.
The accepted-step axis depends on this integrator and tolerance; it is not a physical-time comparison to the original numerical-step axis.
Stepped boundaries in the accepted-step map reflect the saved spatial-profile cadence.
Slip contours show two complete interseismic intervals and closing earthquakes; the original timing and detailed profiles are not recovered.
No separate spatial refinement sequence has been completed for this fixed-pressure reference case.

checks: Panel arrays and both figure files retain their previously verified hashes.
